scope: Existing artifacts only; PostgreSQL 16.14 Census base-relation restriction CE

experiments.name: Census locality
experiments.question: Does the query-candidate graph decompose?
experiments.hypothesis: Many small components may enable component optimization.
experiments.result: 2 components, but one contains 467/468 queries and all 2,253 pair candidates; mean pair-candidate degree 4.44 and mean interaction neighborhood 128.30.
experiments.decision: Abandon connected-component decomposition; retain affected-query locality.

experiments.name: PostgreSQL order sensitivity
experiments.question: Does CREATE/OID order affect MCV estimates?
experiments.hypothesis: Selection may be insufficient to describe a design.
experiments.result: The same selected set produced radically different query.184 estimates under opposite creation orders.
experiments.decision: Represent precedence explicitly; preserve OID order in deployment.

experiments.name: First-applicable / multiple statistics
experiments.question: Is PostgreSQL simply first-statistic-wins?
experiments.hypothesis: A first-applicable rule explains overlap.
experiments.result: Overlap followed first-created behavior approximately, but disjoint statistics both contributed; first-singleton prediction failed by up to 98.91x.
experiments.decision: Model dynamic consumption plus sequential numerical composition.

experiments.name: Consumption/composition
experiments.question: Which objects are consumed and how do contributions compose?
experiments.hypothesis: Winner consumption plus multiplicative corrections reconstructs rows.
experiments.result: Masking identified winners for overlapping and disjoint fixtures; composed predictions were within 1.0143x of rounded native observations.
experiments.decision: Separate control IR, numerical response, and objective IR.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-IR-v0
experiments.question: Can a five-candidate design-parametric replay cover all subsets?
experiments.hypothesis: GreedyCover plus probed responses is sufficient.
experiments.result: 32/32 designs within 5%; maximum relative error 1.08087% against rounded observations.
experiments.decision: Remove singleton probes and validate native raw quantities.

experiments.name: CE-Replay-IR-v1
experiments.question: Can replay derive numerical responses directly from payloads?
experiments.hypothesis: Serialized MCV payload fields suffice.
experiments.result: 128/128 designs within 5% across four targets; max apparent error 1.7495%, later attributed to observation artifacts.
experiments.decision: Add native pre-clamp instrumentation.

experiments.name: Native v1-B validation
experiments.question: Does external replay equal native pre-clamp CE?
experiments.hypothesis: Remaining error is rounding/clamping.
experiments.result: 128/128 floating-point matches; maximum relative error 5.55e-16.
experiments.decision: Freeze MCV replay semantics as validation oracle.

experiments.name: Optimize-v0
experiments.question: Can replay drive an exact small physical-design loop?
experiments.hypothesis: Replay and native exhaustive optima agree.
experiments.result: All 32 designs and budget thresholds enumerated; replay selected the native exact optimum at every threshold; deployed rows within 2.70e-16.
experiments.decision: Scale to the complete Census pair universe.

experiments.name: Optimize-v1
experiments.question: Do dependency-aware evaluation and contextual search matter at scale?
experiments.hypothesis: Marginal evaluation beats singleton ranking and incremental replay is cheap.
experiments.result: At 2,253 candidates incremental toggle evaluation was 47.7x faster; random/singleton/marginal/local losses were 4922.86/6966.36/812.67/806.26; seven deployed designs gave 3,276/3,276 native matches.
experiments.decision: Study semantic move neighborhoods and precedence.

experiments.name: Optimize-v2
experiments.question: Can semantic neighborhoods restrict SWAP and precedence search?
experiments.hypothesis: Local interactions contain most opportunity.
experiments.result: Of 3,768 improving swaps, 58.23% were disconnected budget exchanges; one-hop search reached 806.162 in 13.24s; precedence refinement reached 802.113 in 0.847s.
experiments.decision: Keep a global budget-exchange channel and treat precedence as a design dimension.

experiments.name: Optimize-v3
experiments.question: Are selection and precedence coupled?
experiments.hypothesis: Alternating refinement improves beyond either alone.
experiments.result: Loss fell from 812.671 to 795.512 in four alternating rounds; selection after order changes contributed additional improvement.
experiments.decision: Record coupling, but keep later mixed experiments fixed-precedence.

experiments.name: MCV-Deploy-v0
experiments.question: Does fresh physical deployment preserve semantic fidelity?
experiments.hypothesis: Replay matches native on the fresh snapshot while loss drifts from frozen payloads.
experiments.result: Frozen/fresh loss 795.512/813.802; +2.2992% payload drift; 468/468 semantic matches, max error 5.64e-15.
experiments.decision: Separate semantic error from ANALYZE realization uncertainty.

experiments.name: FD-Semantics-v0
experiments.question: Can a second, internally different CE mechanism be replayed?
experiments.hypothesis: Source-derived dependency selection and application are executable externally.
experiments.result: Native FD scenarios matched exactly; applicability and MCV-to-FD composition were validated.
experiments.decision: Extend IR through an explicit MCV-to-FD boundary.

experiments.name: Optimize-v4
experiments.question: Does joint MCV+FD semantics change physical design?
experiments.hypothesis: Independent optimization wastes budget on suppressed FD objects.
experiments.result: Joint loss 806.444 versus independent 813.942; independent selected 97 FD objects of which 72 were never consumed; joint selected 54 with none unconsumed.
experiments.decision: Build a compositional incremental optimizer.

experiments.name: CE-Semantic-State-v0
experiments.question: Can projected execution state safely merge design histories?
experiments.hypothesis: Control/output state may be restart-safe.
experiments.result: Projected state compressed current executions but failed extension safety; a lower-OID addition exposed a previously irrelevant selected candidate.
experiments.decision: Distinguish execution-sufficient from restart-sufficient state; retain structural dependencies.

experiments.name: MCV-Commutativity-v0
experiments.question: Can partial-order reduction remove transition interleavings?
experiments.hypothesis: Independent MCV actions commute.
experiments.result: 31.37% of enabled pairs commuted and disjointness was exact on Census, but PostgreSQL already executes one canonical OID schedule.
experiments.decision: Do not target execution interleavings as the main search explosion.

experiments.name: MCV-Semantic-Factorization-v0
experiments.question: Can response functions factor over semantic components?
experiments.hypothesis: Compact factor tables may avoid subset enumeration.
experiments.result: Scalar multiplier composition was tolerance-exact for 3,374,717 designs, but every nonempty Census candidate graph was connected; structural reduction was zero.
experiments.decision: Return to incremental search over local dependencies.

experiments.name: Semantic-Move-Pruning-v0
experiments.question: Can exact SWAP evaluation avoid most control replay?
experiments.hypothesis: Cached toggle responses and safe bounds accelerate one round.
experiments.result: 95.29% globally cache-eligible; selected order pruned 35.10%; zero false positives; same best SWAP; 25.19x fewer control replays.
experiments.decision: Test cache validity across a complete trajectory.

experiments.name: Semantic-Optimizer-v0
experiments.question: Does MCV-only acceleration remain exact across rounds?
experiments.hypothesis: Structural invalidation preserves the exhaustive local trajectory.
experiments.result: 17 accepted moves plus terminal round matched completely; 93.39% cached numerical, 1.89% pruned, 171.31x fewer control replays, 3.51x runtime speedup; Qreal-only invalidation failed and Qstruct fixed it.
experiments.decision: Make counterfactual structural invalidation a system invariant.

experiments.name: Compositional-Semantic-Optimizer-v0
experiments.question: Does exact incremental evaluation generalize to MCV+FD?
experiments.hypothesis: The mechanism boundary enables exact reuse.
experiments.result: 19-move trajectory matched; 95.13% numerical-only, 0.19% FD-only, 4.54% MCV+FD replay; locality and mechanism reuse reduced control work 58.89x and another 154.61x, but runtime was 145.68s versus 45.05s for the factorized oracle.
experiments.decision: Treat numerical aggregation and move iteration as the bottleneck; do not claim mixed runtime speedup.

experiments.name: Mixed-Deploy-v0
experiments.question: Does fresh mixed deployment preserve native/replay equivalence?
experiments.hypothesis: Fresh payload replay matches native while differing from frozen optimization payloads.
experiments.result: Frozen/fresh/native losses 805.316/819.191/819.191; payload drift +1.7229%; semantic loss error 0; 468/468 within 1e-12, max relative error 8.05e-16; storage -102 bytes; two FD payloads disappeared and became unconsumed.
experiments.outcome: strong positive semantics, visible deployment uncertainty
experiments.decision: Close the current physical loop and prioritize payload-robustness evidence.

exactness.semantic: Supported for the tested PostgreSQL 16.14 base-restriction MCV+FD fragment.
exactness.move_evaluation: Supported for tested deterministic ADD/DROP/SWAP trajectories.
exactness.search_optimality: Not supported beyond explicitly enumerated small universes.

global_optimum_evidence.result: Exact global optimum and native agreement.
Singleton, marginal, and local search found tested exact optima; random was slightly suboptimal at one budget.
